'''František Makeš''' (9 December 1931 – 16 January 2025) was a Swedish artist, scientist and chemist, specialising in the [[Conservation-restoration of cultural heritage|conservation of art objects]].

[[File:Frantisek makes fraktaler1-261x300.jpg|thumb|Fractals I]]

==Life and career==
Makeš was born on 9 December 1931. He studied at the [[Academy of Fine Arts]] in [[Prague]]. In the mid-1960s, he participated in the preservation work of the Royal collection in Prague and reached great international fame for his [[Conservation-restoration of cultural heritage|conservation]] work. After the occupation in 1968 he moved to Sweden and continued his research, where he was awarded a [[Ph.D.]] degree by the [[University of Gothenburg]].

He worked, among other things, as chief curator of the [[Skokloster Castle|Skokloster castle]] and its art collections.

In 2005 Makeš was awarded the "Gratias Agit Award" by the [[Czech Ministry of Culture]].

In 2006 Makeš was awarded [[H. M. The King's Medal]] 8th size in silver with a blue ribbon for significant and sustained action on the preservation of art and painting, mainly in connection with the art collections at [[Skokloster]].

Internationally, he is recognized for his scientific approach regarding the disclosure of imitation paintings and for his two patents in biochemistry. Makeš continued his research with [[polarographic analysis]] and is thus in the footsteps of [[Jaroslav Heyrovský]] who received the [[Nobel Prize in Chemistry]] in 1957. Makeš's latest research focuses on how he – whoever wants to – can best preserve their cultural heritage.<ref>Makeš, F. (2006): ''Novel enzymatic technologies to safeguard cultural heritage''. Studies in Conservation 16, Gothenburg, Sweden</ref>

Towards his later years, František dedicated more and more time towards his art. Many of his artworks are based on what he saw under the microscope.

Makeš died 16 January 2025, at the age of 93.<ref>{{Cite web |agency=[[Czech News Agency]] |date=17 January 2025 |title=Zemřel František Makeš. Restauroval slavné obrazy, odhalil falzifikát Rembrandta |url=https://www.idnes.cz/zlin/zpravy/frantisek-makes-zemrel-svedsko-zlin-malir-restaurator-biochemik.A250117_162228_zlin-zpravy_jfuk |access-date=17 January 2025 |newspaper=[[Mladá fronta Dnes]]|publisher=[[Mafra (company)|Mafra]]}}</ref>
